name: What, So What, Now What?
deliverable: Ladder of inference progression: observations, interpretations, actions

steps.text: Ask the group to list only what happened, one observation per note, with no interpretation or judgment.
Read the observations together and remove anything that already contains a cause or an opinion.
Ask what patterns or meaning the observations carry, and record the different readings side by side.
Turn to implications: what does this mean for the work or the people involved?
Finish by naming concrete next actions, owners, and when the group will check them.

failure: The room jumps straight to opinions and fixes, so the group argues about interpretations without agreeing on what actually happened.
intervention: Point at the observation column and say: "Before we explain it, what did we actually see? Facts first; meaning next."
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
